description: Gold-labeled extraction cases for the peripheral-nerve sample tree. Each case is a realistic patient utterance; `expect` lists ONLY the variables the utterance genuinely supports (its option key). Any variable the extractor returns that is NOT in `expect` counts as a spurious/over-extraction (false positive). `expectRoute` is the specialist name (or "escalate") the deterministic engine should reach given the correct high-confidence values.
